article.headline: Utah faces conference rival San Antonio
article.description: San Antonio Spurs (2-2, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-3, 13th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Utah faces conference rival San Antonio
article.linkText: Utah faces conference rival San Antonio
article.story: San Antonio Spurs (2-2, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-3, 13th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Wednesday, 9 p.m. EDT LINE: Spurs -12.5; over/under is 234.5 BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio faces Utah in Western Conference action Wednesday. Utah went 22-60 overall, 12-40 in Western Conference play and 14-27 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Jazz gave up 126.0 points per game while committing 21.1 fouls last season. San Antonio finished 62-20 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Spurs averaged 119.8 points per game while allowing opponents to score 111.5 last season. INJURIES: Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee), Lauri Markkanen: day to day (wrist), Jaxson Hayes: day to day (shoulder). Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
